quote: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: The turn is a left turn from a two-directional highway onto a one-way highway, the approach for the left turn must be made in that portion of the right half of the highway nearest the centerline thereof, and the turn must be made by turning from the right of the centerline where it enters the intersection as close as practicable to the left-hand curb of the one-way highway.

activation.condition: Driver intends a left turn at an intersection from a two-directional highway onto a one-way highway.

obligation.description: Approach in the right half nearest its centerline; turn from the right of the centerline where it enters the intersection as close as practicable to the destination left-hand curb.

timing.description: Measure approach before entry, full-body position at centerline entry, and departure toward the one-way left curb.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: as close as practicable to the left-hand curb of the one-way highway
judgment_calls_needed.note: Preserve original full-body departure distance, Native left curb and physical constraints; do not assign a legal distance cutoff.

parameter_refs.name: approach_target_offset_m

parameter_refs.name: departure_target_offset_m
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: positive engineering lateral target in m inside surveyed one-way destination

parameter_refs.range_or_domain: original full-body centerline offset, m; unknown until Native execution

parameter_refs.range_or_domain: original full-body destination left-curb distance, m; unknown until Native execution
